title: DEV-LOOP-01 Canonical Queue and Safe Runner Integration
purpose: Connect the existing development control plane to the existing supervisor/worker loop so approved milestone work can run safely from one canonical queue.
problem: The legacy sequencer reads Markdown objectives from .opencode while active milestones live under development/, performs destructive cleanup, and continues after failed work.

included: Use development/milestones JSON records as the canonical runnable queue
Select only explicitly active or ready milestones with satisfied dependencies and no blockers
Render the selected milestone into the existing supervisor objective contract
Remove destructive tracked-file cleanup and stale-branch deletion
Stop on failure, blocker, held work, hand-back, or approval-required delivery
Preserve dedicated branches, lifecycle state, closeout, validation, and provenance
Add npm run dev:loop with dry-run and test coverage
Update existing operator, status, handoff, and closeout documentation
excluded: Creating a new worker or supervisor architecture
Automatic pushing, pull-request creation, or merging
Public-network exposure or changes to Local Brain authority boundaries
New top-level architecture layers or milestone packages

acceptanceCriteria.description: The runner discovers eligible work only from development/milestones and never activates planned, blocked, dependency-blocked, CTK-02, or DBVT work.

evidence.note: Canonical selection, planned and blocked exclusion, dependency gates, and actual dry-run selection passed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The runner contains no tracked-file reset or forced stale-branch deletion and refuses unsafe dirty or conflicting branch state without discarding work.

evidence.note: Tracked reset, forced branch deletion, recursive removal, dirty-tree refusal, and publication boundaries passed.
Dirty-worktree preflight stopped without changing or discarding files.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Failed, blocked, held, hand-back, budget-exhausted, and approval-required outcomes stop the queue before later milestones run.

evidence.note: Failure, held, paused, budget, hand-back, and delivery-approval stop outcomes passed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A completed run preserves the dedicated branch, session, checkpoint, closeout, validation, acceptance evidence, and provenance needed for review.

evidence.note: Dedicated branch, closeout, review, prepare, validate, completion, and control-plane evidence commit sequence passed.
34 lifecycle, review, issue, brief, and closeout tests passed with canonical-state restoration.
46 validation/completion tests and 32 preparation/delivery tests passed.

acceptanceCriteria.description: npm run dev:loop provides a safe operator command and the complete relevant repository validation suite passes.

evidence.note: Complete offline repository suite passed with DEV-LOOP regression coverage included.
Command selected DEV-LOOP-01 from canonical development state and reported no automatic delivery.
